description.value: A year-round outdoor adventure store on Kaslo's Front Street, carrying clothing, gear, and accessories across all seasons. The shop is best known for kayak and paddleboard rentals on Kootenay Lake and snowshoe and nordic ski rentals in winter. Biking is listed among supported activities but the store does not appear to offer dedicated cycling services or bike-specific inventory.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website describes Kaslo Adventure Centre as a general outdoor adventure store selling clothing, gear, and accessories for hiking, biking, camping, paddling, and swimming. Biking is mentioned only in passing within a list of activities — there is no dedicated cycling section, no mention of bike repairs, parts, pumps, rentals, or any bike-specific services. The store's active rental offerings are kayaks, canoes, SUP boards, snowshoes, and nordic skis. OSM tags confirm shop=sports. Address and phone are confirmed on the website's contact page.
concerns: OSM name includes '& Kayaking' but website header uses 'Kaslo Adventure Centre & Outdoor Store' — kayaking appears to be a service line, not part of the store's current branding
No bike-specific content anywhere on the website despite being categorized as Bike Services
Store may carry some basic bike gear as part of general outdoor inventory but this is unconfirmed
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: General outdoor sports store that mentions biking in passing but shows no evidence of bike-specific services, repairs, parts, or rentals. All active rental programs are for paddling and winter sports. May still carry basic bike accessories but cannot confirm any Bike Services required criteria. Worth verifying in person whether they stock bike tubes, pumps, or offer basic mechanical help.

provenance.category_correction_reason: This is a general outdoor sports store, not a bike services shop. Biking is mentioned once in a list of summer activities but no bike-specific services, repairs, or rentals are offered. May be better categorized as general outdoor retail if such a category exists, or excluded from Bike Services.

wow_evidence: Biking is mentioned only in passing within a list of activities — there is no dedicated cycling section
